result.explanation: Maintain an LRU resident cache, durable map, lifetime versions, and the set of emitted flush versions. Writes dirty entries; acknowledgments persist only the currently flushed version. Reads promote durable values only when a clean slot is available.
result.mapping: Cache entries map keys to value, version, and dirty state; order is oldest-to-newest. Durable stores acknowledged values. Versions survive eviction, and emitted flush versions authorize matching acknowledgments.
result.assumptions: Event values are finite JSON values and keys are strings. Unknown event types are treated as no-ops. The supplied slot count is a positive integer.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output))return false;for(const o of output){if(!o||!Array.isArray(o.cached)||!Array.isArray(o.dirty)||!Array.isArray(o.flush)||!o.durable||o.cached.some(k=>typeof k!=="string"||k.includes("__changed")))return false}return true}
